title: Store Manager
jobDescription:
Job Description for Store Manager – Carat Lane

RESPONSIBILITIES

Business management and development

  • Knowledge of handling Retail Store Operations

  • Selling & customer service

  • Good knowledge of Jewellery - Gold, Diamond, Platinum and Silver will be an added advantage

  • MIS Reporting

  • Responsible for the definition and achievement of the sales target for the store and to achieve/exceed them in alignment with his/her team.

  • Guardian of the relationship of store VIPS, team with Sale Associates as often as necessary to help them build stronger relationships and customer delight initiatives, lead and develop new opportunities in the market.

  • Meet and/or exceed the KPI’s.

  • Lead and drive the commercial ambition of the market in coordination & be responsible for the business planning.

  • Act as pilot and review regularly the monthly Store dashboard with his/her team, submit quarterly related action plan, accountable for results

  • Review competition trends, create a strong network within the New Delhi, recommend/initiate changes for maximizing goals and objectives

Client relationship Management and Care Service

  • Share clientele development initiatives and feedback collected from team members

  • Ensure that each customer receives outstanding service

  • Maintaining outstanding standards, product knowledge and all other components of customer service

  • Manage and maintain in relation with the CRM an updated list of clienteles.

  • Ensure attention to existing and new recruitment of VIPs, clients, and prospects, effectively creating a database for boutique sales and marketing activities


Team management

  • Ensure proactivity of all Store staff members: Jewellery Consultants and support teams

  • Hire, lead, and act as advisor to store team regarding tasks and operations

  • Ensure coaching of team, individual, and collective objectives with on-the-job training, appraisals, task allocation, and feedback on expectations

  • Foster a cooperative and harmonious working climate conductive to maximize employee morale and productivity. Reinforce continuously respectful communication between all departments

  • Assess training needs for her team and plan their career evolution

  • Challenge team toward autonomy and organize areas of responsibilities in the store on products of segments.

  • Organise regular staff meetings to train staff on new product launches

  • Monitor staff appearance and behaviour, in line with company policy and boutique guidelines

  • Recommend salary adjustments, transfers, promotions



Boutique operation management

  • Ensure compliance with all policies and procedures through regular store management and staff meetings

  • Supervision of/and support to the Operational Boutique Manager to ensure:

    • Service excellence within the boutique and team

    • Excellence for overall appearance and maintenance of the boutique in accordance with Maison guidelines.

    • Compliance with operations procedures

    • Accuracy of quarterly stock take and application of all measures to avoid stock discrepancies

    • Daily follow-up with regional head office for stock replenishments, active order requests, reporting

    • Implementation of visual merchandising or architectural initiatives

    • Store walk-through and audits, etc

Financial Control

  • Compliance with group procedures and legal, fiscal and customs regulations

  • Cash registry controls



EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Preferably a holder of a Bachelor Degree or a Masters Degree

  • A minimum of five years prior retail management experience in the luxury sector (watches and jewellery ideally or hospitality)

  • Experience within a flagship or highly visible boutique essential

  • Ability to motivate, cultivate, develop and lead a team in line with Cartier’s image

  • Strong culture and ability to interact easily with VIPs

  • Excellent interpersonal, organizational, analytical, oral and written communication skills

  • Excellent representation of the brand inside and outside the boutique

  • Proven track record of networking capacities

  • Computer proficiency (Microsoft office)

title: Product Designer II
jobDescription:
You will be responsible for improving services and co-create innovative user experiences online website/app. The UX designer in the team will be the leader of “omnichannel glue” that will also bring together and bind the physical and digital retail experiences & will work more on a feature to feature basis but the large process will include improving the online ecommerce through researching, developing and testing ideas.

You will also plan, organise resources & make Carat Lane stores frictionless with the aim of creating a quality customer experience at the website/app.


Essentially Product designer will look at two major context at Carat Lane :

1. Pre-purchase. The service design activities that work to enhance the experience when the consumer is in the moment to engage online.

2. Post-purchase. The service design activities that create amazing experiences after the consumer has turned into a customer. All post-purchase activities start at the moment the consumer has parted with his/her money, right through to the point the consumer receives the product.

It’s important to note that both pre- and post-purchase comprise a mix of “front of house” and “behind the scenes” activities. You will collaborate with Online - Product Design, Tech & Management along with the Merchandise team. Our consumer sees and experiences everything the theatre production teams want them to see or hear, however, there is an army of people, activities, and workflows occurring behind the scenes. (the script, direction, lighting tools, orchestra etc.). Any issues/faults that lie within the backstage will translate to a degraded performance and experience for those watching. More than that, ‘what & why’ motivates and demotivates our buyers online is something you will identify. Think of yourself as the director of the theatrical performance which defines success as all moving parts (front and back) working perfectly together to present the desired pitch, a perfect performance or a wow frictionless Purchase of the jewellery.

About the role and responsibilities

Here are a few things you should know about this ROLE: This is a challenging role and most of what you design will not be trivial. You’d be expected to put in a lot of dedication, take a lot of feedback, explore a lot of possibilities and keep iterating to arrive at solutions.

  • You will be responsible for designing interfaces and experiences for a variety of ecommerce palettes and touchpoints. You will work very closely with almost everyone in the team — including the CXOs

  • You are expected to bring in-depth thought process behind your work, document decisions and see a project/ feature through inception, development to going live

  • You should have the ability to work on multiple projects, work with the team to prioritize as needed while receiving strategic and tactical direction

  • You will, over time, create, maintain and own a comprehensive library of design assets for reusable, semantic and atomic designs.

  • You will be responsible for producing groundbreaking enterprise application designs for Desktop Web, i Phone (i OS), Android and i Pad and would be expected to understand design paradigms for each.

  • You will be expected to generate pixel-perfect production assets with superb attention to detail

  • You should have the ability to work well in an ego-free, highly collaborative, and cross-functional team

  • You’ll be required to present findings, insights in a consumable format to the broader team. Interacting with users, constantly documenting their experiences, expectations in a consumable format for the team is non-negotiable to you

  • You should be an excellent communicator. You’ll be expected to be extremely proactive in keeping relevant stakeholders in the loop as your work and findings progress. This is extremely important to succeed at Carat Lane.

  • You should be able to convey your thoughts (well backed by insights & observations you got collaborating with PMs ) concisely and persuasively to other stakeholders of the project — verbally and in writing

  • You will gradually evolve to become one of the gatekeepers for user experience before a feature project hits production.

You may be a fit for this role if you have at least 2-3 years of solid work experience :

  • You have a portfolio showcasing meticulous details of your visual design work

  • You have a strong sense of color, typography, and design composition

  • You should be knowing design & prototyping tools like Sketch and Invision.

  • Bonus points for additional skills like animation, illustrations using tools like Principle, After Effects, Framer etc.

  • You have a portfolio showcasing meticulous details of your thought process, how you collect user inputs, behaviour and translate those to tangible design solutions in the form of polished, high-fidelity wireframes

title: Technical Lead - AI
jobDescription:
Experience: 7+ years

Role Overview:
We are seeking an experienced and hands-on AI/ML Tech Lead to join our AI/ML team. This role demands a strong technical leader who can architect, guide, and deliver scalable AI solutions while actively contributing to code and model development. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in machine learning, computer vision, LLMs, and deployment practices, along with prior experience in leading and mentoring a team of engineers.

Key RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead the development and deployment of AI/ML models and API-based services across domains like Computer Vision, LLMs, and Agentic AI.

  • Guide and mentor a team of at least 4 AI/ML engineers, ensuring high-quality technical output and team growth.

  • Own infrastructure and Dev Ops decisions related to AI model serving, optimization, and monitoring.

  • Collaborate with Dev Ops, Data Engineering, and Product teams for seamless integration and delivery.

  • Evaluate and adopt emerging AI frameworks and tools to improve development velocity and model performance.

Required Skills:

  • 7+ years of experience in AI/ML, with at least 2 years in a technical leadership role guiding a team.

  • Proven hands-on experience in deploying production-grade ML models using Docker, Fast API/Flask, and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Deep understanding of version control (Git), containerization, and MLOps practices.

  • Proficiency in Python, Py Torch/Tensor Flow, Open CV, and Hugging Face/Transformers.

  • Exposure to agentic AI workflows, prompt engineering, and GPU-based training/inference.

  • Experience working with cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure) and managing compute/GPU resources

title: Software Engineer - II
jobDescription:
We are looking for a skilled Oracle Fusion Consultant with 2 to 5 years of experience specializing in Order to Cash (O2C) and Invoice flows. The ideal candidate will also have hands-on experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), Oracle APEX, and strong proficiency in PL/SQL and Oracle Database concepts. The candidate will play a critical role in supporting ongoing migration activities, improving system performance, and ensuring the stability and scalability of our ERP processes.


Key RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Analyze and understand existing migration activities, including customizations and integration flows.
  • Ensure system stability and data consistency across all modules and integrations.
  • Diagnose performance bottlenecks in Fusion, OIC integrations, and database processes; propose and implement optimizations.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve migration-related issues and bugs efficiently.
  • Implement new enhancements and changes across Oracle Fusion, OIC, and APEX based on business needs.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams for testing, deployment, and documentation of integration flows.


Required Skills & Qualifications.


  • 2 to 5 years of hands-on experience in Oracle Fusion, specifically in Order to Cash (O2C) and Invoice modules.
  • In-depth understanding of Fusion O2C and Invoicing flows
  • Strong experience working with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) for complex end-to-end integrations.
  • Should have worked in one end to end implementation project.
  • Hands-on-experience on BIP reports
  • Proficiency in Oracle APEX for custom UI development and backend logic.
  • Solid understanding of Oracle Database architecture and expertise in PL/SQL for writing and optimizing queries, procedures, and packages.
  • Experience in handling system performance tuning and debugging
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to work independently and in a team.

title: Senior Executive
jobDescription:
Job Title: Architectural Draughtsman (Retail Stores)

Experience: 5+ Years

Reporting To: Architect / Assistant Manager – Design

Role Overview

We are looking for a skilled Architectural Draughtsman with strong experience in retail store design and execution drawings. The role involves preparing detailed architectural drawings,coordinating with design and execution teams, and ensuring accuracy and compliance with brand and technical standards.

Key Responsibilities

● Prepare detailed architectural drawings, layouts, and working drawings for retailstores (plans, elevations, sections, and details).

● Translate design concepts into accurate technical drawings using Auto CAD (orsimilar software).

● Support architects/design managers in developing store design solutions alignedwith brand guidelines.

● Develop Good for Construction (GFC) drawings and ensure timely delivery forproject execution.

● Coordinate with internal teams (design, project management) and externalconsultants/vendors.

● Review site measurements and incorporate site-specific conditions into drawings.● Maintain drawing standards, documentation, and version control.

● Assist in value engineering and optimization of design details.

● Ensure drawings comply with local building codes, regulations, and mall/landlordrequirements.

● Provide support during site execution for clarifications and revisions.

Required Skills & Qualifications

● Diploma in Architecture, Civil Engineering, Drafting, or Interior Design.● Minimum 3+ years of experience,preferably in retail/store design.

● Strong proficiency in Auto CAD (mandatory); knowledge of Sketch Up/Revit is aplus.

● Good understanding of materials, construction details, and retail fixtures.● Ability to read and interpret architectural and MEP drawings.

● Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

● Good coordination and communication skills.

Preferred Experience

● Experience working on retail chains, mall stores, or high-street formats.● Exposure to fast-paced rollout projects and multi-location execution.● Familiarity with brand guideline-driven design systems.

Key Competencies

● Detail-oriented and organized

● Ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously

● Problem-solving mindset

● Team collaboration
